title.narrative: Emergency Health and Protection assistance for Individuals in Libya affected by the conflict in Sudan

description.narrative: The objective of this 6-month project is to provide multisectoral lifesaving humanitarian assistance focusing on protection services and health assistance for Sudanese in Libya. The project is expected to alleviate the suffering and improve the living conditions of Sudanese and host populations in various cities in the East of Libya. The proposed rapid humanitarian engagement under this project rests on two core pillars: I- Health: Particularly the provision of primary health care and MHPSS services to affected individuals, and the provision of essential emergency medical equipment and medicines to two health facilities II- Protection: Through direct assistance and referrals to specialized protection services, enhancing the existing referral pathway mechanisms, and the provision of dignity kits to women and girls in close coordination with the newly activated Protection taskforce.
